subject: project:gdl
value: Fourteen ACCEPTED records cite a source path that is not in the tree, so their evidence cannot be reopened as written. Surfaced for the first time by the run-35 stale anchor_path_missing check (reopen_candidates was otherwise EMPTY, so these are 14 findings the queue could not previously produce). Twelve were stranded by the movieplayer.c -> movieplayer.cpp rename of 2026-08-31: attempt.fn-800da920-trio-verify-exact.20260831.v1, attempt.fn-800dacd8-trio-drive.20260831.v1, attempt.fn-800db3d4-trio-drive.20260831.v1, attempt.fn-800db3d4-trio-drive.20260831.v2, attempt.fn-800dba80-report-retriage.20260829.v2, attempt.movieplayer-defakematch-tupass.20260830.v1, attempt.movieplayer-defakematch-tupass.20260831.v2, attempt.playvqmovie-gxcolor-layout.20260829.v1, claim.law.guard-polarity-restructure-fixes-count-parity-not-form.20260831.v1, claim.law.low-field-count-param-retype-can-regress-exact.20260830.v1, claim.law.narrow-type-buys-rlwimi-insert-and-pays-a-masked-shift.20260901.v1, evidence.moviestate-layout-proof.20260831.v1. Two were stranded by directory moves: attempt.shop-c-defakematch-tupass2.20260831.v1 cites src/game/leveldata.h (now include/game/leveldata.h) and attempt.sndfxinit-signature-and-mode-global-fix.20260831.v1 cites src/game/sfx/sndfx.c (now src/game/audio/sndfx.c). The repair in every case is SUPERSEDING the record with the corrected anchor, never deleting it - each row names its single surviving file. Note the run-34 criticism this came from concerned attempt.playvqmovie-gxcolor-layout.20260829.v1 specifically: MV reported it as describing a layout the tree no longer produces, which is a SECOND defect this check does not test for - a corrected anchor does not re-verify the content, and the movieplayer records should be re-measured against the .cpp before their claims are relied on.
